fn:beginEdit.cost: starts one row/column draft using the current effective cell value and stable row ID.

fn:cancelEdit.cost: discards only the active draft and returns false when nothing was active.

fn:cell.cost: O(1) overlay lookup plus frozen base access; staged values are visible to render.

fn:changes.cost: O(edits), at most 4096 entries; preserves first-edit order in a frozen snapshot.

fn:clearEdits.cost: O(edits), plus O(rows) to refresh an active filter.

fn:clearFilter.cost: restores every source row in the current full sort order; O(rows) index rebuild.

fn:commitEdit.failure: stages the draft; capacity failures keep it active for correction or cancellation.

fn:create.cost: O(cells); frozen row-major data is shared, not materialized in the scene. Legacy row IDs are positional.

fn:createWithIds.cost: O(rows + cells + row ID bytes); validates unique bounded IDs and keeps frozen cell data shared.
fn:createWithIds.failure: Shape/Capacity/Text/RowId/DuplicateRowId; IDs are 1..64 UTF-8 bytes, at most 65536 rows and 1048576 cells.

fn:deleteRequest.cost: O(1); reports the selected row's stable ID when the event is the Delete key and no draft is open. It never deletes: call it before dispatch, and call removeRow when the application accepts the deletion.

fn:dispatch.cost: edit failure EditRejected keeps the draft open when commit fails; text input is ignored when prefix:edit is not rendered.
fn:dispatch.failure: Range/Id/Text; wheel and Up/Down/Home/End move the selected row or viewport. F2 starts a draft on the selected row at the focused column (Left/Right); while a draft is open, Enter commits, Escape cancels, and key/text input edits prefix:edit (Up/Down are ignored). Callers re-render after Edit* actions.

fn:draft.cost: returns the active uncommitted cell edit; render shows it in the textbox prefix:edit, and cell/changes/toValue still see only committed values.

fn:editCell.cost: O(1), except bounded edit removal or active-filter refresh over at most 8192 rows; max 4096 staged cells and 4 MiB of value bytes.

fn:editCellId.cost: resolves stable row IDs in O(1), including filtered-out rows; an active filter refresh scans at most 8192 rows.

fn:filterByText.cost: O(rows + scanned cell bytes); case-sensitive substring match in the current full sort order. Empty query clears filtering. Non-empty query is limited to 8192 source rows and 256 UTF-8 bytes.
fn:filterByText.failure: Range/FilterRows/FilterQuery; failures leave view and selection unchanged.

fn:removeRow.cost: O(rows * columns) frozen reads (each read of a frozen list is charged its length, so keep tables small); needs caller-supplied row IDs. Staged edits and an open draft of the row are dropped, the selection follows the other rows by identity, sort order and filter are kept.
fn:removeRow.failure: LegacyIds/UnknownRow; failures leave the table unchanged.

fn:render.cost: O(columns + visible rows * columns); relative column weights consume the full inner width, with at least one pixel per column. New view keeps failures away from the caller's published scene.
fn:render.failure: Bounds/Id; weighted column widths have a 1-pixel minimum, row height 16..128, caller publishes the returned view. An open draft in the viewport renders as a focused textbox prefix:edit with the saved caret.

fn:rowIndex.cost: returns the current display position; None means unknown or filtered out. Cost O(1) with caller IDs, O(id bytes) for legacy positional IDs.

fn:rows.cost: returns total source rows, independent of the active filter.

fn:scroll.cost: O(1); clamps arbitrary signed deltas before adding them.

fn:selection.cost: returns the selected row's current display position; use selectionId for stable identity.

fn:setColumnWeights.failure: accepts one positive relative weight per column; maximum 65535. A failed call leaves the previous configuration unchanged.

fn:setDraft.failure: accepts at most 4096 valid single-line UTF-8 bytes; failures preserve the existing draft. The caret moves to the end.

fn:sortByText.cost: descending=false is ascending, true is descending. Stable ties retain current full sort order; cost O(n log n) comparisons plus bounded indexes. Limits: 8192 source rows and 256 UTF-8 bytes per key.
fn:sortByText.failure: Range/SortRows/SortKey; any failure leaves order, filter, selection, viewport, and staged edits unchanged.

fn:toValue.cost: maps one row by stable ID in O(columns), including staged edits and filtered-out rows.
fn:toValue.failure: UnknownRow for a missing ID; Conversion includes the row ID and mapper error. The table is not mutated.

fn:visibleRows.cost: returns the number of rows in the current filtered view in O(1).
